import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts'] if isinstance(data,dict) and 'texts' in data else data
for i,el in enumerate(texts):
    t=el.get('text','') if isinstance(el,dict) else str(el)
    if re.search(r'telephone|registrant|amazon.com, inc\\.', t, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',el.get('page_no'), 'TEXT', t[:400].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"

item.text: I found the cover-page contact section. I’m reading the surrounding text elements to capture the exact telephone number as printed in the filing.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts']
for i,el in enumerate(texts[:80]):
    t=el.get('text','')
    if any(ch.isdigit() for ch in t) and ('Seattle' in t or '980' in t or 'Washington' in t or 'Nasdaq' in t or 'telephone' in t.lower()):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',el.get('page_no'),repr(t))
PY"
